Render the whole comparison from a set of files

Source: R/report.R
compare_report.Rd

The one-call entry point: hand it a spec of ride files and it reads them, puts them on a common clock, and reports how the meters compare overall, across the power range, and — where one meter is common to more than one run — between meters that never rode together.

Usage

compare_report(
  spec,
  output_file = "power-comparison.html",
  min_power = 0,
  width = 25,
  min_seconds = 30,
  block = 60,
  replicates = 1000,
  max_offset = 30,
  smooth = 30,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

spec

Data frame with columns path, run and source, as built by ride_spec_from_names(), or the path to a directory of ride files named <run>_<source>.

output_file

Path of the HTML file to write.

min_power

Both sources must exceed this to count, in watts.

width

Bin width for the power-range breakdown, in watts.

min_seconds

Power bands with fewer paired seconds than this are dropped.

block

Bootstrap block length in seconds.

replicates

Number of bootstrap replicates.

max_offset

Largest clock offset to consider, in seconds.

smooth

Window of the rolling mean on the power traces, in seconds.

seed

Seed for the bootstrap. The intervals are resampled, so two runs over the same rides differ slightly unless this is set.

Value

The path of the rendered file, invisibly.

Examples

compare_report(demo_rides(), tempfile(fileext = ".html"))
